purpose: Pre-declare the decision rule, margins and stopping rule of the evidence-chain acceptance run before the acceptance artefact is produced. Pilot work (fixture construction, scanner debugging) happened before this file; the two pilot defects and their effect on the measured association rate are recorded in 'pilot_findings' below rather than being silently absorbed.
decision: Adopt uncertainty-aware equivalence (TOST) certificates for capability upgrades and reclassify historical point-PASS declarations by their MDE coverage.
alternatives_considered: keep the point rule 'relative error < 15%' (rejected: no sampling-uncertainty statement, PASS cannot be falsified by more data)
raise the sample size only (rejected: does not fix the missing interval / MDE reporting)
report post-hoc power only (rejected: post-hoc power is a deterministic function of the p-value and is not a design property; MDE coverage + power-at-zero are reported instead)
hypothesis: Real solver verification artefacts already carry enough numeric evidence to upgrade capability claims to REAL without human intervention, and a fraction of historical PASS declarations is statistically non-certifying.
unit_of_analysis: one verification artefact file for association; one capability entry for equivalence; one historical PASS/FAIL record for reclassification
stopping_rule: One acceptance run after the test suite is green; no re-run with altered margins or value ranges to improve a failing criterion. If a criterion fails, it is reported as FAIL with the measured number.

pilot_findings.finding: naive association definition counted artefacts whose only matched leaves belonged to another repository's capability, reporting 33 % association
pilot_findings.fix: recognition is now repo-scoped: a file counts only if a capability declared for the same repository matched

pilot_findings.finding: per-repository file caps truncated whole directories (artefacts/..., benchmarks/... swallowed the budget before docs/), and files beyond the per-capability sample cap were counted as unbound
pilot_findings.fix: file caps raised so that every matching artefact is scanned; accepted files tracked separately from the truncated sample

pilot_findings.finding: analytic TOST power initially used the observed s/ sqrt(n) as the normal scale instead of the population sigma/sqrt(n), overestimating the failure probability by ~4x when the margin is wide
pilot_findings.fix: power quadrature corrected and validated against Monte-Carlo (tolerance 3-4 MC standard errors) inside the test suite

analysis_plan.aggregation: per capability entry: TOST decision, dual interval, achieved power, MDE; per artefact: bound/unbound with reason; per claim: one of six classifications
analysis_plan.uncertainty: intervals reported at 1-2*alpha = 90 %; power/MDE from analytic quadrature (mean, variance) and Monte-Carlo with fixed seed (distribution)
analysis_plan.outliers: behind a declared value_range per metric family (documented in the config); the number of excluded observations is reported per group
analysis_plan.missing_data: reported as WITHHELD_* decisions, never imputed
analysis_plan.comparison: each decision is stated against its own declared margin, so no cross-capability averaging is used

environment.repositories: local ecosystem checkout; per-repository git commit recorded in the artefact

interpretation_limits: capability samples pool different benchmark cases, so they are not independent repeated runs; the interval is a descriptive statement about the artefact population, not about a single run
cross-solver variance/distribution entries are descriptive comparisons of evidence streams, not physics equivalence claims
file caps and value ranges restrict the population; excluded counts are reported
historical reclassification is limited to declarations that expose machine-readable values, thresholds, sample sizes and spreads
